name: @bernouy/cms-bloc-compile
description: Bloc compile pipeline — builds a bloc's view + editor browser bundles from author sources (`prepare_bloc`), validates tags (`validateBloc`), and rewrites the authoring import specifiers (`@bernouy/cms-blocs/base`, `@bernouy/cms-control/editor`, …) to the `window.p9r` globals via `p9rExternalsPlugin`. Those specifiers are an authoring CONVENTION intercepted at build time — never resolved from disk, so this package depends on no surface.
